# Vanduo Framework v1.3.9 — LLM Context

You are an expert Vanduo Framework developer. Vanduo is a **pure HTML/CSS/JS framework** for consumers (no build required to use it) with **zero runtime dependencies** and a **Fibonacci / Golden Ratio design system**. v1.3.9 ships **47+ components** plus Glass Effects, Water Morph, and Expanding Cards, and the current worktree sets Theme Customizer defaults to `charcoal` neutral plus `ubuntu` font while Theme Switcher and Theme Customizer remain separate tooling surfaces that coordinate through shared theme-preference state. The repository uses a minimal build pipeline (esbuild + lightningcss) to produce the `dist/` outputs.

---

## Core Principles
- **No build tools for consumers**: include CSS in `<head>`, JS at end of `<body>`.
- **Naming safety**: all framework classes are prefixed with `vd-`.
- **Design system**: spacing, type, and layout follow Fibonacci / Golden Ratio.
- **Themeable**: separate runtime Theme Switcher and Theme Customizer surfaces + data attributes on `<html>`.
- **Dual naming**: many components have a standard name and a unique Vanduo alias (e.g., Carousel → Flow, Popover → Bubble, Scrollspy → Waypoint).

---

## Defaults (v1.3.x)
Set by Theme Customizer when no user preference exists:
- Primary color in light mode: `black`
- Primary color in dark mode: `amber`
- Neutral color: `charcoal`
- Border radius: `0.5`
- Font family: `ubuntu`
- Theme: `system` (follows OS)

---

## Quick Start (Local)
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="system">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/vanduo.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/icons/icons.css" />
  <title>Vanduo Page</title>
</head>
<body>
  <nav class="vd-navbar vd-navbar-fixed">
    <div class="vd-navbar-container">
      <a class="vd-navbar-brand" href="#"><i class="ph-fill ph-drop"></i> Vanduo</a>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <main class="vd-container vd-py-8">
    <h1>Hello Vanduo</h1>
    <button class="vd-btn vd-btn-primary">Action</button>
  </main>

  <script src="js/vanduo.js"></script>
  <script>Vanduo.init();</script>
</body>
</html>
```

---

## Quick Start (CDN)
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/vanduo-oss/framework@v1.3.9/dist/vanduo.min.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/vanduo-oss/framework@v1.3.9/dist/vanduo.min.js"></script>
<script>Vanduo.init();</script>
```

---

## Quick Start (With a Bundler — Vite)

> **Bare module specifiers require a bundler.** Do NOT use `import '@vanduo-oss/framework/css'` in a plain `<script type="module">` — browsers cannot resolve bare specifiers. Use the CDN or Local options for static HTML.

```bash
pnpm create vite my-app --template vanilla
cd my-app
pnpm add @vanduo-oss/framework
```

```js
// main.js
import '@vanduo-oss/framework/css';
import { Vanduo } from '@vanduo-oss/framework';
Vanduo.init();
```

---

## Naming Conventions
- **All classes**: `vd-` prefix
- Examples:
  - `vd-container`, `vd-row`, `vd-col-6`
  - `vd-btn`, `vd-btn-primary`
  - `vd-card`, `vd-card-glow`
  - `vd-input`, `vd-form-group`

---

## Theming (Runtime)
Theme Customizer writes attributes to `<html>`:
- `data-theme="light|dark|system"`
- `data-primary="blue|cyan|indigo|..."`
- `data-neutral="charcoal|zinc|gray|slate|..."`
- `data-radius="0|0.125|0.25|0.375|0.5"`
- `data-font="open-sans|ubuntu|rubik|..."`

These values persist via `localStorage`.

When Theme Switcher and Theme Customizer are both present, they share `vanduo-theme-preference` and Theme Customizer only swaps between `PRIMARY_LIGHT` and `PRIMARY_DARK` while the active primary color is still on the per-theme default.

---

## Layout & Grid
### 12-Column Grid
```html
<div class="vd-container">
  <div class="vd-row">
    <div class="vd-col-12 vd-col-md-6">A</div>
    <div class="vd-col-12 vd-col-md-6">B</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Fibonacci / Golden Ratio
- **Row-based**: `vd-row-fib-3`, `vd-row-fib-4`, `vd-row-golden`
- **Grid-based**: `vd-grid-fib-3`, `vd-grid-fib-4`, `vd-grid-golden`
- **Toggle mode** (JS): add `data-layout-mode="standard"` and use `[data-grid-toggle]`

---

## Utilities (Examples)
- **Spacing**: `vd-m-5`, `vd-p-8`, `vd-gap-5`, `vd-gap-fib-13`
- **Text**: `vd-text-primary`, `vd-text-muted`, `vd-text-sm`
- **BG**: `vd-bg-primary`, `vd-bg-success`, `vd-bg-dark`
- **Per-hue colors** (v1.2.6+): `vd-bg-{color}-{shade}`, `vd-text-{color}-{shade}` (13 hues × 10 shades)
- **Borders**: `vd-border`, `vd-border-primary`, `vd-rounded-md`
- **Shadows/Glow**: `vd-shadow-lg`, `vd-hover-glow`

---

## Complete Component Inventory (47+)

### Layout & Navigation
| Component | CSS Class | JS Module | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Navbar | `.vd-navbar` | `navbar` | Fixed/sticky, responsive hamburger |
| Sidenav | `.vd-sidenav` | `sidenav` | Slide-in drawer, overlay |
| Offcanvas | `.vd-offcanvas` | `sidenav` | Multi-direction (top/right/bottom/left) via `data-vd-position` |
| Breadcrumbs | `.vd-breadcrumb` | — | CSS-only |
| Pagination | `.vd-pagination` | `pagination` | |
| Footer | `.vd-footer` | — | CSS-only |
| Tabs | `.vd-tabs` | `tabs` | |
| Stepper | `.vd-stepper` | `stepper` | Linear/free-form wizard steps |

### Data Display
| Component | CSS Class | JS Module | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cards | `.vd-card` | — | Glow, actionable, image variants |
| Collections | `.vd-collection` | — | CSS-only lists |
| Badges | `.vd-badge` | — | CSS-only |
| Chips | `.vd-chip` | — | CSS-only |
| Alerts | `.vd-alert` | — | CSS-only |
| Avatar | `.vd-avatar` | — | CSS-only |
| Skeleton | `.vd-skeleton` | — | CSS-only loading placeholder |
| Timeline | `.vd-timeline` | `timeline` (optional) | CSS-only vertical timeline; add `.vd-timeline-animated` for staggered reveal. Scroll mode: one `IntersectionObserver`. With `.vd-timeline-alternating`, desktop entrance is left/right (narrow: vertical). With `.vd-timeline-playback`, use `data-vd-timeline-prev|next|play|pause` buttons (no observer). Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` |
| Tree View | `.vd-tree` | `tree` | Expandable/checkable nested lists |
| Code Snippet | `.vd-code-snippet` | `code-snippet` | Syntax display with copy |

| Popover / Bubble | `.vd-bubble` | `bubble` | Rich content, smart positioning |

| Spotlight | `.vd-spotlight` | `spotlight` | Feature discovery tours with programmatic start and declarative `data-vd-spotlight` triggers |

### Effects & Enhancements
| Component | CSS Class | JS Module | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Glass Effects | `.vd-glass` | `glass` | Frosted glass surfaces; size variants `vd-glass-sm/md/lg/xl`; modifiers `vd-glass-tinted`, `vd-glass-floating`, `vd-glass-contrast`; opt-in component variants via `.vd-*-glass`; scroll-activation via `data-glass-scroll` |
| Water Morph | `.vd-morph` | `morph` | Liquid wave content-swap effect; size variants `vd-morph-sm/lg`; custom `--vd-morph-wave-color`; programmatic `VanduoMorph.morph(el)`; `data-vd-morph` for declarative opt-in, `data-vd-morph="manual"` to skip auto-init |
| Ripple / Waves | `.vd-ripple` | `ripple` | Material-style click ripple |
| FAB | `.vd-fab` | — | CSS-only floating action button |
| Sticky / Affix | `.vd-affix` | `affix` | Automatically sticks within the nearest scrollable container, with viewport fallback and `is-stuck` events |
| Scrollspy / Waypoint | `.vd-waypoint` | `waypoint` | Active-link tracking via IntersectionObserver |

|---|---|---|---|

| Component | CSS Class | JS Module | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Theme Customizer | `.vd-theme-customizer` | `theme-customizer` | Runtime theming UI with primary/neutral/radius/font/theme controls; coordinates with Theme Switcher when both are loaded |
| Theme Switcher | — | `theme-switcher` | Light/dark/system toggle with shared theme preference |
| Font Switcher | — | `font-switcher` | Font family swap |
| Doc Search | `.vd-doc-search` | `doc-search` | Documentation search modal |
| Grid Toggle | — | `grid` | Fibonacci/standard layout switch |

## JavaScript API

### Core
```js
Vanduo.init();             // initialize all components (required)
Vanduo.reinit('dropdown'); // reinitialize a specific component
Vanduo.destroyAll();       // cleanup all components
```

### Toast (programmatic)
```js
Vanduo.components.toast.show({
  title: 'Success',
  message: 'Saved.',
  type: 'success',      // success | error | warning | info
  duration: 3000
});
```

### Carousel / Flow
```js
Vanduo.components.flow.next(element);
Vanduo.components.flow.prev(element);
Vanduo.components.flow.goTo(element, index);
Vanduo.components.flow.destroy(element);
```

### Popover / Bubble
```js
Vanduo.components.bubble.show(trigger);
Vanduo.components.bubble.hide(trigger);
Vanduo.components.bubble.hideAll();
Vanduo.components.bubble.destroy(trigger);
```

### Music Player
```js
VanduoMusicPlayer.init();
VanduoMusicPlayer.initPlayer(element, {
  tracks: [{ name: 'Track', url: '/audio/track.mp3' }],
  showProgress: true,
  showPlaylist: true,
  shuffle: false,
  volume: 0.5
});

VanduoMusicPlayer.play(element);
VanduoMusicPlayer.pause(element);
VanduoMusicPlayer.next(element);
VanduoMusicPlayer.previous(element);
VanduoMusicPlayer.setVolume(element, 0.8);
VanduoMusicPlayer.setTrack(element, 1);
VanduoMusicPlayer.getState(element);
VanduoMusicPlayer.destroy(element);
```

### Water Morph (new in v1.3.5)
```js
VanduoMorph.init();          // auto-init all .vd-morph / [data-vd-morph] elements
VanduoMorph.morph(element);  // trigger morph programmatically (wave from center)
VanduoMorph.destroy(element);
VanduoMorph.destroyAll();
```

### Scrollspy / Waypoint
```js
Vanduo.components.waypoint.refresh(navElement);
Vanduo.components.waypoint.destroy(navElement);
```

### Stepper
```js
Vanduo.components.stepper.setStep(element, index);
Vanduo.components.stepper.next(element);
Vanduo.components.stepper.prev(element);
Vanduo.components.stepper.destroy(element);
```

### Rating
```js
Vanduo.components.rating.getValue(element);   // returns number
Vanduo.components.rating.setValue(element, 4); // set to 4 stars
Vanduo.components.rating.destroy(element);
```

### Transfer
```js
Vanduo.components.transfer.getSelected(element); // returns selected items
Vanduo.components.transfer.destroy(element);
```

### Tree View
```js
Vanduo.components.tree.getChecked(element); // returns checked node values
Vanduo.components.tree.destroy(element);
```

### Spotlight / Feature Discovery
```js
Vanduo.components.spotlight.start([
  { target: '#step1', title: 'Welcome', description: 'Start here.' },
  { target: '#step2', title: 'Next', description: 'Then this.' }
]);
Vanduo.components.spotlight.next();
Vanduo.components.spotlight.prev();
Vanduo.components.spotlight.stop();
```

### Form Validation
```js
Vanduo.components.validate.validateForm(formElement);
Vanduo.components.validate.addRule('customRule', validatorFn, 'Error message');
Vanduo.components.validate.destroy(formElement);
```

### Draggable (v1.1.8+)
```js
Vanduo.components.draggable.makeDraggable(element, { data: 'value' });
```

---

## Data Attributes (Complete)

### Core / Existing
- `data-modal="#id"` / `data-dismiss="modal"`
- `data-tooltip="text"` / `data-tooltip-placement="top|right|bottom|left"`
- `data-toggle="theme"` / `data-toggle="font"`
- `data-collapsible`
- `data-grid-toggle="#selector"`
- `data-theme-customizer-trigger`
- `data-draggable="value"`
- `data-sidenav-toggle="#css-selector"` — value **must be a CSS selector** (include the `#`)

### Introduced in v1.3.5
- `data-vd-morph` — enables Water Morph effect on any element; auto-initializes click handler that triggers liquid wave content swap
- `data-vd-morph="manual"` — marks element for morph CSS but skips auto-init (for custom JS control)

### Introduced in v1.3.4
- `data-glass-scroll` — marks any `.vd-glass` element for scroll-activated glass; transparent at rest, frosted when sentinel exits viewport
- `data-glass-sentinel="<CSS selector>"` — points to the sentinel element watched by IntersectionObserver; defaults to previous sibling when omitted
- `data-scroll-threshold="<px>"` — on `.vd-navbar-glass`: custom scroll distance (px) before frosted glass activates; defaults to navbar height

### Introduced in v1.2.7
- `data-vd-flow` — carousel container marker
- `data-vd-bubble` — popover trigger, value is the ID of the popover element
- `data-vd-waypoint` — scrollspy navigation container
- `data-vd-position="top|right|bottom|left"` — offcanvas/sidenav direction
- `data-vd-affix` — sticky element marker
- `data-vd-suggest` — autocomplete input marker
- `data-vd-validate` — form validation marker
- `data-vd-datepicker` — date picker input marker
- `data-vd-timepicker` — time picker input marker
- `data-vd-stepper` — stepper container marker
- `data-vd-rating` — rating widget marker
- `data-vd-transfer` — transfer list marker
- `data-vd-tree` — tree view container marker
- `data-vd-spotlight` — JSON array of tour steps attached to a trigger element for declarative startup

## Key Files
- `css/vanduo.css` — master stylesheet (imports all component CSS)
- `js/vanduo.js` — global JS entry (manual init)
- `js/index.js` — bundled JS entry (imports all component JS)
- `css/core/` — tokens, colors, typography, grid
- `css/components/` — 47 component stylesheets
- `css/effects/glass.css` — frosted glass effect system (new in v1.3.4)
- `css/effects/morph.css` — water morph effect (new in v1.3.5)
- `css/components/expanding-cards.css` — expanding flex image strip (new in v1.3.8, MIT CodePen adaptation)
- `js/components/glass.js` — scroll-activated glass via IntersectionObserver (new in v1.3.4)
- `js/components/morph.js` — water morph click handler and programmatic API (new in v1.3.5)
- `js/components/expanding-cards.js` — expanding cards click + keyboard focus (new in v1.3.8)
- `js/components/timeline.js` — timeline reveal: `IntersectionObserver` for scroll mode, or playback controls for `.vd-timeline-playback` (staggered `.is-revealed` on `.vd-timeline-animated`; new in v1.3.8)
- `js/components/` — 38 component scripts
- `css/utilities/` — shadows, tables, transitions, transforms
- `dist/` — production-ready minified build

---

## Icons
Phosphor Icons are bundled locally:
```html
<i class="ph ph-house"></i>
<i class="ph-fill ph-heart"></i>
```

---

## Testing and Tooling

- Tests use **Playwright Test** only (`@playwright/test`).
- Main scripts (from package.json):
  - `pnpm test` – full Playwright suite
  - `pnpm test:a11y` – accessibility-focused tests (`@a11y` tag)
  - `pnpm test:mobile`, `pnpm test:desktop` – viewport-specific runs
  - `pnpm test:chromium`, `pnpm test:firefox`, `pnpm test:webkit` – engine-specific runs
- Configuration:
  - `playwright.config.ts` defines desktop, mobile, and tablet projects.
  - Local server uses Python's `http.server` to serve the repo at `http://localhost:8787`.

Linting and build:
- `pnpm lint` – runs Stylelint for CSS and ESLint for JS.
- `pnpm build` – runs the minimal build pipeline to generate `dist/`.
